title: QIK-VRT Universal Terminal: System Test, Integration Evidence, and Observer-Relative Information Transport
description: Exact-tree-bound system-test and integration record for the Firefox-based QIK-VRT Universal Terminal. The artifact documents transport-neutral information envelopes, separation of temporal/source/destination metadata from trust and execution authority, Effect-Acknowledgement boundaries, and the trusted exact-tree integration path. It does not claim physical signalling into a causal past, PASS, FINAL_PASS, or EFFECT_ACK_DONE.
